instruction: Create a local folder in Thunderbird called CLIENTS.

metadata.explanation: Task requires creating one local folder (CLIENTS) in Thunderbird. The evaluator reuses the existing check_list metric function to verify that both the folder file and .msf index file exist using regex patterns.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies the instruction requirements: checks for both CLIENTS directory and CLIENTS.msf index file
Postconfig correctly executes 'ls -R' on Thunderbird's Local Folders directory to capture filesystem state
Getter (get_cache_file) correctly retrieves the cached ls output for verification
Metric (check_list) correctly uses regex patterns to verify both required components exist
Regex pattern '\bCLIENTS\.msf\b' correctly matches the .msf index file that Thunderbird creates
Regex pattern '\bCLIENTS/?(?!\.msf)' correctly matches the CLIENTS directory (with optional trailing slash, excluding .msf)
Complete coverage: all requirements in the instruction are verified (folder creation verified via both directory and index file)
Data flow is correct: postconfig captures state -> getter retrieves file -> metric validates patterns
Runtime feasibility confirmed: ls command will work, file path is valid for Thunderbird profile, check_list function exists and works correctly
